summary: @edheil Anyone can have free micro.blog account and syndicate with RSS or JSON from anywhere, but if you want a micro.blog page (which is also its instance on the Fediverse and you can follow people from Mastodon) you need to pay, worth it for positive community #mb
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @edheil Anyone can have free micro.blog account and syndicate with RSS or JSON from anywhere, but if you want a micro.blog page (which is also its instance on the Fediverse and you can follow people from Mastodon) you need to pay, worth it for positive community #mb
